b2-concurrent-seat-lost-update.src/seat-inventory.mjs: const events=new Map();export function seedEvent(id,available){events.set(id,{id,available,bookedBy:[]});}export function getEvent(id){return events.get(id)??null;}export async function bookSeat(id,user,audit=async()=>{}){const event=events.get(id);if(!event||event.available<=0)return false;const remaining=event.available-1;await audit();event.available=remaining;event.bookedBy.push(user);return true;}

b1-extend-exhaustive-union.src/shape-area.mjs: const calculators={circle:({radius})=>Math.PI*radius**2,square:({side})=>side**2,rectangle:({width,height})=>width*height,triangle:({base,height})=>base*height/2};export function computeArea(shape){const calculator=calculators[shape.kind];if(!calculator)throw new RangeError(`Unknown shape kind: ${shape.kind}`);return calculator(shape);}

b2-bulk-op-tenant-bypass.src/bulk-archive.mjs: import{archiveItem}from"./archive-item.mjs";import{getItem}from"./item-store.mjs";export function bulkArchiveItems(tenantId,itemIds){const results=[];for(const id of itemIds){const item=getItem(id);if(!item){results.push({id,archived:false,reason:"NOT_FOUND"});continue;}if(item.tenantId!==tenantId){results.push({id,archived:false,reason:"TENANT_MISMATCH"});continue;}archiveItem(id);results.push({id,archived:true});}return results;}

b2-concurrent-seat-lost-update.src/seat-inventory.mjs: const events=new Map();const tails=new Map();export function seedEvent(id,available){events.set(id,{id,available,bookedBy:[]});}export function getEvent(id){return events.get(id)??null;}export async function bookSeat(id,user,audit=async()=>{}){const previous=tails.get(id)??Promise.resolve();let release;const turn=new Promise((resolve)=>{release=resolve;});tails.set(id,previous.then(()=>turn));await previous;try{const event=events.get(id);if(!event||event.available<=0)return false;event.available-=1;event.bookedBy.push(user);await audit({eventId:id,userId:user});return true;}finally{release();}}

b2-order-refund-terminal-leak.src/refund-service.mjs: import{getOrder}from"./order-store.mjs";import{recordRefund}from"./ledger.mjs";export async function processRefund(id,amount,write=recordRefund){const order=getOrder(id);if(!order)throw new Error("order not found");if(!(amount>0))throw new Error("invalid refund amount");const entry=await write(id,amount);if(!entry?.recorded)throw new Error("refund was not recorded");Object.assign(order,{status:"REFUNDED"});return order;}

b2-partial-validation-mutation.src/apply-patch.mjs: const allowed=new Set(["open","closed"]);export function applyPatch(record,patch){const status=patch?.status;if(typeof status!=="string")throw new TypeError("status is required");if(!allowed.has(status))throw new RangeError("invalid status");record.status=status;return record;}
